name: @sos-2/experiments
description: SOS 2.0 Experiments: the controlled evolution plane — Experiment artifacts (spine envelopes, frozen kind Experiment) with treatment/control or alternatives design, typed POPULATION and ALLOCATION semantics (typed units and assignment), primary/secondary/GUARDRAIL metrics, stopping and rollback criteria; the strict SHADOW -> CANARY -> CONTROLLED_EXPERIMENT lifecycle with typed staged exposure levels; typed result records linked to the candidate AND the causal hypothesis through VERIFIES/OBSERVES/CAUSED_BY trace links with truthful 6-state availability; guardrail evaluation where a FAILING or UNKNOWN guardrail is never silently treated as success; typed stopping/rollback trigger records with exact conditions; and a deterministic fixed-seed in-memory simulator whose outcomes are marked simulated and never presented as intervention evidence (Work Order W9, parallel slot C; requirements R13, R14, R21).
